title: Global Energy Review 2026 — Technology: Battery storage
book_use: Chapter 11 primary evidence for 2025 battery-storage deployment: 108 GW added globally, up 40% year over year, installed capacity eleven times 2021 levels, around 80% of additions utility-scale, LFP around 90% of deployments, and storage durations gradually lengthening beyond the still-common two-hour project
notes: IEA states that 108 GW of new battery storage capacity was deployed worldwide in 2025, 40% more than in 2024, with installed capacity eleven times higher than in 2021; around 80% of additions were utility-scale and LFP represented around 90% of deployments. The report also says most projects still cluster around two hours while more four-hour-plus projects are appearing. Treat these as deployment statistics and technology-mix observations, not evidence that short-duration batteries can provide seasonal storage or replace transmission and firm generation.
